why: Weekly theme 'B2B Founder-led Growth' — Pillar: INDUSTRY_BREAKDOWN
draft:
Buyers no longer respond to cold pitch decks.

They research you on LinkedIn before they ever open your email.

Your profile is not a resume. It's your executive landing page.
Your content is not noise. It's your ongoing sales presentation.

If you aren't visible where your buyers hang out, you don't exist to them.

When was the last time you refreshed your personal profile messaging?
